description: GLB v2 boundary samples for the inspectGlbBytes contract surface. Each sample is a byte-exact base64-encoded GLB; byteLength must equal the decoded byte count.

validMinimal.note: Minimal GLB v2 with a single JSON chunk; inspection succeeds with a bounds-unavailable warning.

validWithBinaryChunk.note: GLB v2 with a JSON chunk and one embedded 4-byte binary buffer.

invalidMagic.note: Header magic replaced with 'LIF\0'; container is not a GLB.

unsupportedVersion.note: Header version is 1; only GLB version 2 is supported.

lengthMismatch.note: Declared header length (52) exceeds the supplied byte length (48).

trailingJunkTruncatedChunk.note: Trailing bytes leave a truncated final chunk header.

invalidChunkJson.note: JSON chunk payload is not valid JSON.

missingAssetVersion.note: glTF JSON does not declare asset version 2.0.

unsupportedRequiredExtension.note: Bounded inspector rejects any declared extension, required or not.
